title: My workday
description: Clock in and out, review your records and report discrepancies.

punch.title: Today's punch
punch.hint: Punch without a physical clock for home office or field work. The server records the time.
punch.dayClosedHint: You already recorded today’s punches. You can punch again tomorrow.
punch.channelHint: Check in from the web or your physical clock: all your punches show here.
punch.locationNotice: Your location is saved only when you punch; there is no continuous tracking. Your company has this turned on.
punch.clockOnlyHint: Your company records your workday with the time clock. Here you can see your punches and report anything that's off.
punch.channelHintNoClock: Punch from the web or the app: all your punches show here.
punch.remoteOffHint: Your company turned off remote punches. Ask HR to enable it if you need to punch from here.
punch.appOnlyHint: Your company records punches from the mobile app. Here you can see your punches and report anything that's off.

telework.title: My telework
telework.notRegistered: You are not registered as a teleworker. HR can register you.
telework.noPolicy: No text captured by the client yet.
telework.consentPending: You must accept the current policy and notice.
telework.checklistHint: Initial at onboarding and periodic (every 12 months). Answer every item.

items.space_adequate: The workspace is adequate and exclusive
items.ergonomics: Chair, desk and screen meet ergonomic conditions
items.electrical_safety: Electrical installation is safe and risk-free
items.connectivity: There is a stable internet connection
items.emergency_plan: Emergency plan and contacts are known
items.equipment_inventory: Assigned equipment is inventoried and in good condition
items.no_risk_conditions: There are no risk conditions at the workplace

admin.title: Telework (NOM-037)
admin.description: Policy, privacy notice, teleworkers, checklists and out-of-hours communications.
admin.policyHint: Current versions: policy {{policy}}, notice {{privacy}}. Changing a text bumps its version and the worker must accept it again. Legal validation is out of scope.
admin.contactsHint: Log the contact and the worker gets an in-app notice (right to disconnect).

record.title: My work record
record.hint: Confirm your week to keep a record of your hours.
record.noAck: You have not confirmed any week yet.

requests.title: Overtime requests
requests.hint: Your employer asks for authorization; accepting or rejecting does not change the record of time worked.

config.title: Client settings
config.description: Define how your company operates: week start, schedules and lateness.
config.weekStartHint: Applies to schedules, payroll, overtime and attendance reports.
config.retentionText: Schedules configure entry/exit tolerance, meal break and overtime minimum.
config.attendanceHint: Defaults for new schedules: tolerances, meal break and overtime minimum.

leave.title: Vacation and leave
leave.hint: Check your available days and request vacation or leave.

agreements.methodTitle: Before you start: how your workday is recorded
agreements.scheduleTitle: Your company proposes a workday agreement
agreements.scheduleHint: If you accept, the longer days in this agreement count as regular hours, not overtime. If you disagree, do not accept it and talk to Human Resources.

done.weekDiscrepancy: We sent your discrepancy to HR.
done.discrepancy: We sent your report to HR.
done.leaveRequested: We sent your request to HR.
